# Moco

MOCO is a business management software offering project management, time tracking, and invoicing solutions.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/moco/.

## Actions

- **Create Company**: Create a new company.
- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice.
- **Create Planning Entry**: Create a new planning entry.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in moco.
- **Create Purchase**: Create a new purchase.
- **Delete a company**: Delete a company.
- **Delete Deal**: Delete a deal.
- **Get Activity**: Retrieve a single activity by id.
- **Get Deal**: Retrieve a single deal by id.
- **Get Offer**: Retrieve a single offer by id.
- **Get Planning Entry**: Retrieve a single planning entry by id.
- **Get Project**: Retrieve a single project by id.
- **List Activities**: Retrieve activities.
- **List comments**: Retrieve a list of comments.
- **List Contacts**: Retrieve a list of contacts.
- **List Deal Categories**: List deal categories with their ids and probabilities.
- **List Deals** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all deals (leads).
- **List Invoices**: Retrieve a list of all invoices.
- **List Offers**: Retrieve a list of all offers.
- **List Planning Entries**: Retrieve a list of all planning entries.
- **List Projects**: Retrieve a list of all projects.
- **List Users**: List all users.
- **Update Activity**: Update an existing activity.
- **Update Deal**: Update an existing deal.
- **Update Project**: Update an existing project.
